status: engineering review; reference parity and blind preference unaccepted
changes: Retain user-authored foliage tint/transmission, green roughness 0.46, wet pebble palettes/roughness and fine/coarse soil pigments. These are optical priors, not physical calibration from a rendered image.
Document optional full plant detail distance and add its missing GUI metadata; review profile explicitly chooses 24m while omitted High retains 48m.
Replace unconditional mesh-only RGB extinction with one parent-gated spherical local weather layer shared by primary regular/conforming terrain, water and meshes.
Use existing environment uniform/publication, sky source, Low isotropic fallback and clear zero-work shader branch; no new draw, GPU resource, scheduler or attachment.

comparison.display: 1280x720; 4xMSAA; PBR Neutral; EV100 12.80; TAA/jitter off; no HUD
comparison.sampling: 20s prestream; 30 warmup frames; 48 measured; serial headless GPU completion; not game FPS
comparison.interpretation: Single runs, revised transport and extinction/source policy. No isolated speedup, subjective winner or general error guarantee claimed.

observations: Distant foliage no longer has an independently stronger blue/grey fade than the ground/water.
Existing wet ground and pebble optical detail retained; this change does not add soil geometry.
Repeated crown silhouettes, coarse pinnae, weak root/soil transitions and flat sky/cloud composition remain.

known_limits: Equilibrium sky-source approximation in a homogeneous authored local layer; full physical finite-segment atmospheric transport and local-weather transport on secondary rays unported.
No soil subgrid normal residual was added. Existing fine height pages, optical texture filtering, exact ground contact and collision limits remain.
Optical priors are not measured fossil leaf/mineral spectra or sea-aerosol data; no physical meteorology claim.
One fixed location, limited sweep and one GPU/backend. No temporal-flicker acceptance, blind votes, reference parity, remote CI or game-FPS claim.
No new fundamental CBT topology or terrain source changes. Moving topology remains asynchronous; only measured/static counters and existing bounded fallback are reported.
